name: day-trader-skill-india
description: The Day Trader skill pack for Claude, adapted for the Indian market (NSE)

plugins.name: day-trader-skill-india
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for day trading NSE stocks: a chart scanner, a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner on the NSE tick, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions before and after charges, a risk manager with Zerodha's charges and price bands, a budget manager, an order executor (paper by default, Zerodha Kite when you go live, never without your yes), price alerts, a results analyst and a Pelosi tracker.
